title: Hightouch Sync Failures
dataSources: Hightouch sync run events (`hightouch:sync`), Census sync history (`census:sync`), Segment/RudderStack destination delivery and error events, audience-refresh latency metrics via REST.
app: Hightouch / Census sync webhooks and REST APIs via HEC; Segment/RudderStack delivery events via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=hightouch:sync event=sync_completed
| stats count as syncs, sum(eval(status="failed")) as failures by sync_name, destination
| eval failure_rate=round(100*failures/syncs,1)
| where failures>0
| sort - failure_rate
description: Tracks Hightouch reverse-ETL syncs that push warehouse data into operational tools and flags failures, which starve CRM, ads, and support systems of fresh data.
value: Reverse-ETL failures mean sales, marketing, and support act on stale data in their own tools; catching them protects revenue-facing workflows.
implementation: Configure a Hightouch webhook to HEC (or poll the API); schedule every 15 minutes; alert on failures for revenue-critical syncs.
visualization: Table by failure rate, timechart of sync failures, alert.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the jobs that push fresh data into your sales and marketing tools and flag when one fails, so teams do not act on old data.
